label: early original-phase input of 0/b/d/m/h/s/i/l (positions 1-4)
explanation: Fires mainly (92% of mass) during the original-input phase at early positions t=1..4 (peak t=2-3; never at t=0, almost never at t>=6), when the input token is from a preferred set: 0 (strongest, rate 33%), then b, d, then m, h, s, i, l (y weaker). Looks graded/additive: precision rises to 0.85 when the previous input is also from the set (e.g. s s 0, t s 0, d 0), and 0/b/d fire on their own. Repeated tokens still fire (in_first does not help). Largest activations: 0 at t=2-3 after another preferred token, and 0 at the first copy step of L=3 sequences d 0 x <DEL> d 0. Rarely fires in the copy phase (8% of mass, scattered) and essentially never at the delimiter. Does not fire on z, r, w, most other letters or digits 1-3. Precision is limited because the preferred-token-at-early-position condition is necessary but not sufficient; dev F1 ~0.71, mass recall ~0.87.
